source: Project Operating System Phase 3 - Testing Engine
name: Testing Contract
objective: Define future testing responsibilities for registered assets, baselines, equivalence, regression and approval boundaries.
scope: calculator brand freshness editorial recommendation and adaptive report negative scenarios
distinct copy print and download behavior
article editorial automation positive and negative fixtures
calculator conservative migration positive and negative fixtures
notes: This contract does not add, execute or wire test runners.
Phase 3 details the official Testing Engine protocol under /data/pos/testing.
The calculator experience validator must reject generic report-class pages and preserve justified SIMPLE_SINGLE_STEP/SIMPLE_RESULT cases.
Report-class calculators must test semantic derivation, A4/selectable isolation and distinct COPY_RESULT, PRINT_RESULT and DOWNLOAD_REPORT behavior.
Article fixtures must cover clarity, flow, examples, repetition, intent, freshness, sources, cluster, bidirectional links and anchors.
Legacy article compatibility must not fail existing articles without an explicit migration request.
